#bitcoin  climbed above $90,000 on #Monday  as renewed geopolitical tensions between Russia and Ukraine lifted oil prices and revived inflation hedging across global markets.
The move came after fresh attacks on key energy infrastructure reduced optimism around a near-term peace agreement, triggering a rebound in commodities and risk assets.
Bitcoin and Major Altcoins Rally as Macro Tensions Re-Emerge
Bitcoin rose more than 2%, briefly trading above $90,000, while major cryptocurrencies posted broad gains.
#ETH ,#solana  each advanced 3% or more, according to CoinDesk data.
The rally followed a renewed rise in oil prices, reinforcing Bitcoin’s role as a macro-sensitive asset that often benefits when inflation risks resurface.
Oil Prices Jump After Attacks on Energy Infrastructure
In traditional markets, crude oil prices moved higher as geopolitical risks intensified:
WTI crude rose 1% to $57.24 per barrel
Brent crude gained 0.8% to $60.81 per barrel
The gains followed confirmation that Russia and Ukraine had launched strikes on critical energy facilities over the weekend.
On Sunday, Russian forces attacked Naftogaz’s Kherson Combined Heat and Power Plant, a major heating source for tens of thousands of residents. Meanwhile, Ukraine struck the Syzran oil refinery in Russia’s Samara region, damaging its only primary oil processing unit.$ETH

#SQD  has been in the circle for nearly 10 years. To be honest, in the first two years, I suffered a lot in the contract. 
It's not just once or twice; it's that kind of situation—just finished topping up, turned around to drink some water, and came back to find the position gone. 
#RVV  It was only later that I understood a heart-wrenching saying: 
The market hasn't changed; it's that I was too anxious, too greedy, and took myself too seriously. 

#zec  I can't boast about how much I've made now, but there's one thing I'm sure of— 
I haven't made that kind of 'fatal mistake' in a long time. 
To the brothers who just joined, let me share some heartfelt advice: if you can pay less tuition, do so. 

#ETH  Let's first talk about being trapped. 
Once you're trapped, you want to add positions, fantasizing about bouncing back and leaving? 
Bro, the only purpose of adding positions is to stem the losses, not to double your investment. 
At the moment you add positions, if you're thinking, 'I need to make this back,' 
then you're basically already on the road to the next liquidation. 

Now, let's talk about the market. The quieter it is, the more dangerous it is. 
When the K-line is still, it's often brewing something. 
Especially after a significant rise, that kind of torturous structure, 
don't self-comfort; that's not strength, it's giving you time to get high. 
After a big rise, there must be a pullback; this is an iron law. 

I've always believed in an old saying: 
Buy when there are few people, sell when there are many. 
When everyone is scared and doesn't dare to move, you should calmly observe; 
when your social feed is full of profit charts, you should consider exiting. 
Don't sell when it peaks, don't buy when it crashes; when it's moving sideways, keep your hands steady. 

The third thing: position. 
Being fully invested in the crypto circle is basically sentencing yourself to probation. 
Without leeway, there’s no margin for error; if you make one wrong judgment, you exit directly. 

Lastly, mindset. 
What matters in the crypto circle is never technology, but human nature. 
When you're greedy, you chase; when you're scared, you cut. 
Back and forth, and that's how money disappears.

买在人少的时候，卖在人多的时候。

朋友圈全是收益图，你就该考虑退场了。

Brothers and sisters, listen up, today I'm going to talk about something real.

In the cryptocurrency world, money comes quickly and goes even faster.

Whether you can stay depends not on courage, but on discipline.

#SQD  I was able to roll up from 2000U, relying not on luck, but rather on strategy.

I break down my positions into small chunks, entering and exiting quickly; winning means amplifying, losing means cutting to zero.

Is it exciting? Yes, it is.

#RVV  But the premise is — you must adhere to these five bottom lines.

First Rule: If you're wrong, just leave, don’t get attached

Acknowledge it at the right moment and exit immediately.

Hoping for a rebound will only turn a small loss into a big pit.

Only those who can cut losses have the right to talk about the next trade.

Second Rule: If you make five consecutive mistakes, stop trading

When the market is chaotic, continuing to place orders means your emotions are in control.

Set a 'circuit breaker' for yourself, turn off the screen, wait for the market to calm down, and you will be clearer-headed.

Third Rule: Withdraw profits immediately, don’t trust numbers

The numbers in your account are just illusions.

Take at least half of every profit.

Securing your gains is the only way to clear the pressure.

Fourth Rule: Only trade trends, avoid volatility

When a trend emerges, then take action;

When there’s no direction, it’s better to stay flat.

Because the same tool is a weapon in a trend and a meat grinder in volatility.

Fifth Rule: Always keep positions light

Don’t think about changing your fate in one go.

Light positions lead to a stable mindset;

A stable mindset allows for clear judgment.

Remember this: 

Contracts are not a shortcut to overnight success but a test of whether you can survive long-term.

Once you engrave these five rules into your mind,

You will find that the market starts to treat you 'gently'.

The market never lacks opportunities,

What’s missing is patience, composure,

And the ability to wait, endure, and take profits.

#ZBT  I pushed him from 3000U to 100,000U, but in the end, I personally deleted him: The cruel truth of the cryptocurrency world.

#zec 12 On February 14, I recorded something that completely woke me up.

I watched with my own eyes as a person rolled 3000U into 100,000U,

but it was also me who personally ended this "turnaround journey."

#ETH  When he first arrived, he was the standard person "educated by the market."

He had suffered losses and feared further losses, but was unwilling to leave.

Every day a phrase hung on his lips:

"Bro, if I lose again, I will really quit the circle."

I am too familiar with this state——

Wanting to win quickly, lacking patience, and fearing to miss out.

On the first day, I only allowed him to enter with 10% of his position.

He was stunned: "With this little, what can I earn?"

I only replied:

"You are not here to enjoy; you are here to turn things around."

He hesitated for a long time but still followed through.

Three days later, the account was +48%.

I had him take out the profits separately,

keeping the original position unchanged, not adding, not messing around.

This step is called letting profits generate profits.

In the following days, we almost monitored the market all the time,

every transaction was projected in advance,

if it went well, we only took profits and did not touch the principal;

if it went wrong, we immediately reviewed, and he often stayed up until dawn.

The numbers began to roll:

34000U → 7800U → 80,000U → 25,000U……

On the 26th day, he suddenly asked me:

"Bro, can I teach others now?"

I was silent. It wasn't that he couldn't,

but I felt that—— he was starting to get carried away.

On the 34th day, he didn’t notify me and heavily invested in a scam token,

resulting in a 43% drawdown after a wave. I asked him why he didn't consult me.

He said: "I wanted to test my own judgment."

At that moment, I understood,

he had returned to his old state:

It was not trading, but proving himself.

On the 35th day, I blacklisted him.

Not because of losing money,

but because he forgot the most important lesson——

A real turnaround is never a one-time surge,

but using discipline to repeat the correct actions a hundred times.

In this circle,

some people can go from 3000U to 100,000U,

they are always those who can suppress their desires,

and are not controlled by "gambling mode."

How much capital is not important; what matters is:

Can you roll according to the rhythm, follow the rules,

and when you want to prove yourself, choose restraint.

This is the hardest and most valuable ability in the cryptocurrency world.

content:
#ZBT 我把他从3000U推到10万U，最后却亲手把他删了：币圈翻身最残酷的真相

#zec 12月14日，记录一件让我彻底清醒的事。

我亲眼看着一个人，把3000U滚到10万U，

但也是我，亲手结束了这段“翻身之路”。

#ETH 他刚来时，是标准的“被市场教育过”的人。

爆过仓，怕再亏，却又不甘心离场。

每天一句话挂在嘴边：

“哥，再亏一次我就真退圈了。”

这种状态我太熟了——

想赢快的，没耐心，又怕错过。

第一天，我只让他用10%仓位进场。

他当场懵了：“这么点，能赚什么？”

我只回他一句：

“你不是来爽一把的，你是来翻身的。”

他犹豫了很久，还是照做了。

三天后，账户 +48%。

我让他把利润单独拿出来，

原仓位不动，不加码、不乱来。

这一步，叫利润养利润。

接下来的日子，我们几乎全程盯盘，

每一笔都提前推演，

顺了只抽利润，不碰本金；

错了立刻复盘，他常常熬到凌晨。

数字开始滚动：

34000U → 7800U → 8万U → 2.5万U……

第26天，他突然问我：

“哥，我现在是不是也能教别人了？”

我沉默了。不是他不行，

而是我感觉到——他开始飘了。

第34天，他没打招呼，重仓冲了一个山寨标的，

结果一波下去，回撤43%。我问他为什么不问我。

他说：“我想试试自己的判断。”

那一刻我就明白了，

他又回到了以前的状态：

不是交易，是证明自己。

第35天，我把他拉黑了。

不是因为亏钱，

而是他忘了最重要的一课——

真正的翻身，从来不是一次暴冲，

而是用纪律，把正确的动作重复一百次。

这个圈子里，

有人能从3000U做到10万U，

永远是那些能压住欲望、

不被“赌徒模式”控制的人。

本金多少不重要，重要的是：

你能不能按节奏滚，按规则做，

在想证明自己的时候，选择克制。

这，才是币圈最难、也最值钱的能力。

When the market reverses, they comfort themselves: wait a little longer, place another order, it will come back soon.

Blowing up is never due to bad luck, but a pre-written outcome.

Many people talk about risk control, but in reality, they are just postponing the clearing time;

They think they are seizing opportunities, but essentially they are repeatedly betting on the direction.

but about entering with a plan, adjusting with conditions, and exiting with rules.

The most terrifying thing about the market is not the fluctuations, nor the drawdowns,

but that even when you haven't lost everything, your mindset has already collapsed.

Until I started to rebuild my trading system,

no longer chasing orders, no longer trading on emotions,

I began to study structures, rhythms, order books, and indicators, such as the Bollinger Bands, which are fundamental yet authentic tools.

The first time I strictly followed the rules and steadily profited from a market movement,

in that moment, there was no imagined ecstasy,

only a very clear feeling:

"It turns out that contracts can be traded without relying on gambling."

But to be honest, no matter how good the method is,

if the position is out of control and emotions are high,

the market will still mercilessly bring you back to reality.

For this order, are you using a system or acting on impulse?

Is there logic in your entry, or just a feeling that "it’s going to rise"?

Not setting a stop-loss, is it confidence or an unwillingness to admit mistakes?

The crypto world has never lacked stories of overnight success,

what is truly scarce are those who live long, walk steadily, and gradually become stronger.

whether you truly deserve to stay in this market.

于是重仓、满仓、扛回撤。

行情一反向，就安慰自己：再等等、再一单、马上就回本。

爆掉，从来不是运气差，而是早就写好的结局。

问题不在行情，而在方法、仓位和心态。

很多人嘴上说风控，其实只是把清算时间往后拖；

以为自己在抓机会，本质却是在反复赌方向。

真正的合约交易，从来不是盯着K线瞎猜涨跌，

而是有计划进场、有条件加减、有规则离场。

市场最可怕的不是震荡，也不是回撤，

而是你还没输完，心态已经先崩了。

直到我开始重做交易体系，

不再追单，不再情绪下单，

开始研究结构、节奏、盘口和指标，比如布林带这种最基础却最真实的工具。

我才发现：

市场的信号一直都在，只是以前的我，只想赢快钱。

第一次严格按规则，稳稳吃下一段行情时，

那一刻没有想象中的狂喜，

只有一种很清醒的感觉：

“原来合约，是可以不靠赌的。”

但说实话，方法再好，

如果仓位失控、情绪上头，

市场还是会毫不留情把你打回原形。

​The Bullish Sign: We’re seeing a "bullish divergence" on the 2-day chart (price making lower lows while momentum makes higher lows). This often signals a reversal is coming. ✨
​The Bearish Threat: A "death cross" (where the 100-period EMA moves below the 200-period EMA) is looming. If this confirms, the price might stay suppressed throughout early January. ⚠️
​Sentiment: Most traders on platforms like Hyperliquid are currently "shorting" (betting against) SOL, though some "smart money" accounts are starting to flip long.

​Solana is at a crossroads. While history and ETF demand point toward a January recovery, the technical charts demand patience. If SOL can break above $129, the bulls are back in charge. If it slips under $116, it might be a cold start to the new year. ❄️

title: Ethereum Reclaims the $3,000 Level, Eyes the 50-Day EMA as Momentum Builds
subTitle:
Ethereum has firmly reclaimed the $3,000 psychological level, posting its fourth consecutive daily gain and signaling a steadily improving recovery structure. At the time of writing, ETH is up more than 3%, advancing toward the 50-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) near $3,136 — a critical short-term technical threshold.
A successful daily close above the 50-day EMA would likely reinforce bullish momentum and open the door for a continuation move toward the 200-day EMA, currently located around $3,374. This level represents a potential upside of approximately 11% from current prices and serves as a major trend-defining resistance.
Momentum Indicators Confirm Strengthening Buyer Control
Similar to Bitcoin, Ethereum’s daily momentum indicators are showing clear signs of improvement:
The Relative Strength Index (RSI) has climbed to around 51, decisively reclaiming the neutral midpoint. This shift suggests that buying pressure is beginning to outweigh selling pressure, while still leaving room for further upside before entering overbought territory.
The MACD has avoided a bearish crossover and is now separating positively from the signal line. This development indicates that downside momentum has weakened and bullish forces are gradually gaining control.
Together, these signals support the view that Ethereum’s current move is more than a short-lived bounce and may represent the early phase of a broader recovery attempt.
Key Resistance Zones to Watch
If ETH breaks and holds above the 50-day EMA ($3,136), the following resistance levels come into focus:
$3,250 – $3,280: Minor supply zone and previous consolidation area
$3,374: 200-day EMA, a key medium-to-long-term trend indicator
$3,450 – $3,500: Psychological and historical resistance region
A clean reclaim of the 200-day EMA would significantly improve Ethereum’s overall market structure.
Downside Risk and Support Structure
Despite the improving outlook, Ethereum remains vulnerable to broader market volatility. In a corrective scenario, ETH may retest its ascending trendline support, formed by connecting the swing lows from November 21 and December 18.
Primary support: ~$2,850
Secondary support: $2,720 – $2,750 (previous demand zone)
A daily close below the trendline would weaken the bullish recovery thesis and shift focus back toward a consolidation or corrective phase.
Trade Scenario (Technical Reference Only)
The following levels are provided for educational and market-structure reference purposes only and do not constitute financial advice.
Potential Buy on Pullback:
$2,950 – $3,000 (former resistance turned support)
Breakout Confirmation Buy:

TP2: $3,370 (200-day EMA)
Invalidation / Stop-Loss:
Below $2,850 on a daily closing basis
Risk management remains essential, particularly while ETH is still trading below its long-term moving averages.
Final Thoughts
Ethereum’s ability to hold above $3,000 and challenge the 50-day EMA marks a meaningful improvement in short-term market structure. Momentum indicators support further upside, but confirmation through a sustained breakout is still required. Until then, ETH remains in a recovery phase rather than a confirmed uptrend.

Bitcoin Price Action Explained 📉📈
What we just witnessed was not organic market movement — it was a classic liquidity-driven move.
BTC was trading in an area with:
Heavy short interest
Negative funding
Elevated open interest
Stops stacked above resistance
Once price pushed into thin liquidity, short liquidations kicked in, creating forced buying. This made the move look like a breakout.
But the objective wasn’t continuation.
It was liquidation.
As shorts were closed, that buying pressure became the fuel for the spike. Meanwhile, larger players used this strength to distribute into demand.
You can see it clearly in on-chain and exchange flows — large transfers hit exchanges right after the pump.
Once liquidations were complete, there was no real bid left underneath, and price retraced just as fast as it moved up.
This type of behavior often occurs in highly leveraged environments where liquidity is thin and positioning is crowded.

Lesson:
Chasing green candles during high-leverage conditions is risky. Always watch funding, open interest, and liquidity zones.
Stay patient. The market rewards discipline, not emotion.

与此同时，链上数据揭示了机构的谨慎态度。有巨鲸地址近期通过循环借贷策略后，选择以约2，917美元的均价累计抛售超4万枚ETH，兑现逾1亿美元。这与另一部分机构持续大额质押的行为形成鲜明反差，凸显市场对后市方向的巨大分歧。技术指标上，ETH正测试 2，920美元 附近的关键支撑，并位于多条重要均线下方，短中期趋势呈现弱势。
基本面与宏观：长期叙事坚实，但短期面临流动性考验
尽管短期承压，ETH的长期基本面并未动摇。质押率接近30%、DeFi总锁仓价值稳定以及2026年Glamsterdam升级等预期，构成了核心价值支撑。隐私等关键技术的发展也在持续推进。
宏观层面则是喜忧参半。一方面，日本央行加息等事件并未导致加密货币市场出现恐慌性下跌，显示出一定韧性。但另一方面，全球“廉价信贷时代”的逐步终结，意味着市场流动性环境已发生根本性变化。这对需要大量资金推动的资产而言，是一个持续的背景压力。
总结
短期内，ETH需首先应对巨鲸抛售带来的情绪影响和关键清算阈值的考验。市场将密切关注其能否守住当前支撑区域。长期而言，其走势将取决于宏观流动性环境何时好转，以及其技术升级与生态应用能否持续吸引真实资金。在这个过程中唯有像 @Max_Charity 社区一样，专注于真实价值构建的长期主义者，才能穿越周期，沉淀下坚实的价值基础。

#zec  Trading cryptocurrency for 10 years, starting from delivering food, entering the market with 20,000, rolling it into 40 million U, having faced liquidation and being scammed by shady operations, so now I only recognize Binance as the exchange.
#ETH  I can accept losing everything, but I can't accept being scammed, being taken advantage of, or being manipulated. This makes me seem foolish, I don't care! 

Along the way, I didn't have insider information, nor did I encounter a particularly crazy bull market; it all relied on a set of "dumb methods," gradually flipping back and forth.

In over #beat 3600 days, I've only focused on one thing — treating trading like leveling up in a game, not hasty, refining my skills:

Today, I'm sharing 6 solid insights with you. Understanding one can save you tens of thousands; mastering three can make you more stable than most retail investors.

First: Rapid rise, slow fall means the big players are slowly accumulating.

A sudden spike followed by a slow drop is mostly washing the market; don't rush to cut losses. It's only at the peak that you see a sudden surge in volume, followed by a "bang" and a waterfall drop, leaving others to catch the falling knife.

Second: Fast drop, slow rise means the big players are quietly offloading.

After a flash crash, if it rebounds slowly, don't think it's a bargain opportunity; that might be the last stab.

Don't think, "It has dropped so much already, how much lower can it go?" This thought is the easiest way to trip yourself up.

Third: Volume at the top doesn't mean it's over; lack of volume is what you need to be cautious about.

If there's still volume at a high level, it might still surge; if it's quiet with no volume, that's a signal for a potential crash.

Fourth: Don't be reckless with volume at the bottom; continuous volume is what you can trust.

A single spike in volume might just be bait. You need to first experience a period of fluctuation, then see consecutive days of volume increase; this is the real opportunity to build your position.

Fifth: Trading cryptocurrency is about trading people's sentiments; people's sentiments are hidden in the volume.

The candlestick chart is the result; trading volume is the emotional indicator. If the volume is low, it means no one is playing; if it suddenly increases, it indicates real capital is flowing in.

Sixth: "Nothing" is the real skill.

No obsessions; if you should be in cash, be in cash; if you should buy the dip, then act; remain calm and collected. This isn't about lying flat; it's about honing your trading mindset.

Many people are not unmotivated; rather, they are stumbling around in the dark, forever trapped in the same cycle. Remember, the market is always there, but the rhythm waits for no one.

title: “熊市”里的行情分析，出自大漠茶馆
subTitle:
今天分析下行情，我有很久没分析过了，主要是大家都觉得现在是熊市，没啥好分析的。。。
我先说下自己的仓别情况，手里的现货一点都没动，主要是还是大饼、以太、BNB、BGB、还有一些球币（LAZIO、PORTO），另外我还买了一些ASTER，仓位小，爱咋咋地吧😄

接下来说行情，看图，咱就分析大饼和以太，其他的不看了，大饼是一根趋势线没站住，直接掉下去后，处于一个长时间的震荡区间，好在他的低点没有创新低，什么时候他一直保持不在创更低的低点，并且逐步的抬高，创了更高的高点就有希望了，目前来看9w附近压力还是很大的。

再看以太坊，以太目前跟大饼的走势差不多，压力位在3000附近，这个位置突破了后续才有机会，另外红色的圈也是属于震荡区间，需要他走出这个区间，行情才会改变或者反转，目前看还是不太乐观，所以很多人就在这个压力位开空，寻找做空的机会。

咱们再看下数据，我一般喜欢通过技术面加数据面一起来看。大饼现货与合约的资金积累还行，目前来看都有不同程度的资金流入，后边要持续观察。

再看链上代币流向，这个链上转交易所还是太多了，大饼基本上都是在往交易所转账，去砸盘的。

以太坊资金积累不怎么样，全是砸盘的，资金流入不如大饼，流出居多，链上转交易所比大饼略好，剩下的还是需要耐心等待了，估计这个行情要等到26年了。

title: ETH 下跌 29%，3000 美元阻力成多头噩梦，下行压力巨大
subTitle:
以太坊近几个月表现疲软
自 2025 年 8 月创下历史新高以来，以太坊价格在近几个月持续疲软，第四季度尤其惨淡，下跌幅度超过 29%。尽管市场期待反弹，但技术指标和价格走势显示情况并未改善。最新的图表信号显示，价格已经形成下降三角形结构，这通常预示着价格可能进一步下跌。下降三角形结构出现在经历一轮脉冲式上涨之后，意味着市场多空力量正在重新博弈，而抛售压力仍然存在。#ETH 
技术指标指向进一步下跌
加密分析师 Alpha Trade Scope 指出，以太坊价格图表仍显示出明显的疲软迹象。价格已经跌破下降趋势线，这表明从三个月前开始的下跌趋势仍在延续。市场结构也出现了特征转变（CHOCH），显示以太坊价格不再维持牛市特征，更偏向熊市。不断创出新低的趋势进一步证明了市场抛压仍在增加，短期内难以出现强势反弹。

阻力区逐渐增大
目前以太坊价格在 3000 美元的阻力位下方交易了一段时间，同时处于窄幅震荡区间，主要集中在 2930 至 2960 美元的公允价值缺口（FVG）内。这意味着短期反弹将面临阻力，如果价格试图突破该区间，很可能在阻力区遭遇抛压。技术面显示，多空力量尚未达成平衡，多头需要付出更多努力才能推动价格上行。#BTC 

下行目标与支撑位
如果下跌趋势持续，市场抛压保持，首个下行目标位可能在 2815 美元，这里是首个支撑区域，也是投资者可能触发抛售的初始流动性点。如果该支撑位失守，下一主要目标位在 2748 美元，这一价位被视为重要需求区，买盘压力在此可能增强，从而引发技术性反弹。分析师指出，图表呈现典型的看跌延续形态，如果支撑位被有效突破并得到确认，价格可能继续下行，市场趋势仍偏向熊市。

总结与交易参考
总体来看，以太坊近期走势疲软，价格结构和技术指标显示市场抛压仍在增加，短期内反弹压力较大。下降三角形结构和特征转变进一步印证了熊市格局，3000 美元阻力区是多头必须突破的关键点，而 2815 至 2748 美元的支撑区域则是市场潜在反弹的关键节点。投资者在操作时需要关注支撑位与阻力区的变化，谨慎应对市场可能的进一步下跌，同时留意技术性反弹机会。#代币化热潮

#RVV 10 years of cultivation have gone unnoticed, but one day of enlightenment is known throughout the world. I am 35 years old this year, started trading cryptocurrencies at 24, during the black swan event in March 2020, I invested all my savings, buying the dip at 80 dollars for Ethereum and over 3000 dollars for Bitcoin. That wave of surge pushed my funds to over 9 million, which seemed astronomical to me at the time, but I understood clearly that it wasn't my technical skills that mattered, but my vision, as I hit the right trend. However, such opportunities won't always come by, and I must work harder to refine my skills, my trading intuition, and analyze on-chain tokens.
In 2023, I broke through 40 million. My current life consists of closely monitoring the market and executing a few contracts each day, and I generally don’t worry about money when I go out. I recall Huang Bo's saying: When you have strength, everything around you becomes better.
#zec  I have not experienced business disputes, and I have very few worries. I have the patience to summarize my insights:
1. Most of the time, Bitcoin is the leader in the cryptocurrency market's ups and downs, while strong altcoins may sometimes deviate from Bitcoin's influence and follow their own trends; however, altcoins generally cannot escape its influence.
2. Bitcoin and USDT move inversely; if USDT rises, we should be cautious of Bitcoin falling; when Bitcoin rises, it's a suitable time to buy USDT.
3. Between 12 AM and 1 AM, spikes can easily occur, so domestic cryptocurrency friends may try to set a low buy price for their desired coins before going to sleep and a high sell price; you might just make a profit while sleeping.
4. The time between 6 AM and 8 AM is a crucial moment to judge whether to buy or sell, and it’s also the time to assess the day’s market movement. If it has been falling from 12 AM to 6 AM, and continues to fall during this period, it’s a good time to buy or add positions, and the market will likely rise that day. Conversely, if it has been rising from 12 AM to 6 AM and continues to rise during this period, it’s a selling opportunity, and the market will likely fall.
5. 5 PM is an important point of attention, according to rumors in the community. Due to time zone differences, American cryptocurrency friends are waking up to work, which may cause fluctuations in the market, so pay special attention to #ETH #BTC .
6. There is a saying in the cryptocurrency world about "Black Friday," with several instances of significant drops occurring on Fridays, but there are also cases of surges or sideways movements, so it’s not particularly reliable; just pay a little attention to news.

Still the same saying, still the same saying, a lone sail does not journey far, independence does not easily form a forest.
Many souls perish on the crypto road, and only those with true heart can turn the tide.

#RVV 10年修行无人问，一朝悟道天下知。我今年35岁，24岁开始炒币，2020年312黑天鹅，搭上全部积蓄，抄底了80美金的二饼，3000多美金的大饼，那波大涨我的资金到最高冲到了900多W，那时对我来说，简直是天文数字，但我很明白，我不是技术有多好，而是眼光，是踩中了风口，但往后不会每每能遇到这样的机会，必须更加努力的钻研打磨技术，盘感，分析链上筹码。
2023年突破4000万，我现在的生活就是每天盯盯盘做几单合约，出门基本上不会为了金钱烦恼，想起黄勃说的那句：当你有实力了，身边全是好了。
#zec 我没有经历过跟人扯皮的生意，烦心事很少。我有耐心把我的感悟总结出来：
1、大多数情况下，比特币是币圈涨跌的领导者，以太品质强硬的币有时会脱离比特币影响走出单边行情，山寨币基本逃不脱他的影响。
2、比特币和USDT是反向运动的，如果发现USDT涨了，就要警惕比特币跌；比特币涨的时候是买入USDT的合适时机；
3、每天0点-1点之间容易出现插针现象，所以国内币友可以在临睡前尽量低的挂个心仪币的买入价，尽量高的挂个卖出价，说不定就成交了就是躺赚。
4、每天早上6-8点是一个判断买入或卖出的时机，同时也是判断当天涨跌的时间点，如果0点到6点一直是跌，这个时段仍在跌，是个买入或补仓的时机，当天基本是涨，如果0点到6点一直是涨，这个时段仍在涨，是卖出时机，当天大概率会跌。
5、下午5点是江湖上传言的重要关注时点，时差关系，美国币友起床干活了，可能会引起币的涨跌波动，所以要特别留心#ETH #BTC 
6、币圈有“黑色星期五”的说法，有过几次碰巧周五大跌的情况，但也有大涨或横盘的情况，不算特别准，稍微留意消息面即可

Bitcoin's Supply Shock: The 120k Block Warning ⚠️₿
Alright, let’s break down the Bitcoin hype without the confusing "crypto-bro" lingo! 📉🚀
​Here is the lowdown on those 120,000 blocks everyone is buzzing about:
​🧱 The "Block" Basics
​Think of Bitcoin being born in batches called blocks.
​One new block pops up roughly every 10 minutes ⏰.
​Right now, we’re 120,000 blocks away from a major event called The Halving.
​✂️ What is "The Halving"?
​It’s exactly what it sounds like! Bitcoin has a built-in "inflation brake." When the halving hits:
​The amount of new BTC being created is cut by 50%.
​Miners (the people running the network) get paid half as much for their work.
​Basically, Bitcoin becomes twice as hard to get overnight. 💎
​📈 Why do people care?
​It’s basic economics: Supply vs. Demand ⚖️
​Supply drops: Fewer new Bitcoins are entering the market daily.
​Scarcity kicks in: Bitcoin becomes more like "digital gold."
​Price action: Historically, when supply tightens and people still want to buy, the price starts to climb. 🧗‍♂️
​🧘 Keep your cool, though...
​Don't expect a "get rich quick" button on the actual day!
​It’s usually a slow burn, not an instant explosion. 🕯️
​The real "moon mission" often takes a few months to actually kick in.
​The Bottom Line: Halving = Less new supply = More scarcity = Long-term vibes are very bullish. 🦁

💸 Why is crypto falling even with the world flooded in liquidity?
Social media is buzzing with the “logical” question: if the Fed, U.S. Treasury, and China are pumping billions into the economy, why isn’t crypto booming?
The answer: today’s liquidity isn’t 2020’s liquidity. Money doesn’t automatically chase risk anymore.
1️⃣ Liquidity ≠ crypto capital
Fed buys T-Bills, Treasury releases funds, China stimulates banks.
But much of this liquidity:
• Stays in banks
• Covers losses, credit, and operations
• Doesn’t flow into BTC or ETH
So “money poured in” ≠ “capital flooded crypto.”
2️⃣ Investors focus on the future
Crypto reacts to expectations, not immediate inflows.
Global economic risks
Central bank volatility
Strong USD
Cool appetite for high-risk assets
The market now behaves professionally — assessing probabilities, not chasing hype.
3️⃣ Structural market change
Crypto is no longer a “scream in the dark.” It’s:
Part of institutional portfolios
Risk- and macro-aware
Focused on quality over narrative
Meanwhile:
High leverage
Periodic liquidations
Weak altcoins
Cautious big players
“Pour money → prices soar” is over.
4️⃣ Why this is healthy
Market maturity is normal.
Liquidity now stabilizes, not stimulates.
Crypto rewards contextual understanding, not blind optimism.
💡 Takeaway from @MoonMan567:
Not every liquidity wave fuels crypto. The new game favors those who read reality, not chase magic.

title: 🚨Bitcoin Attracts Capital as Silver Margin Crisis Sparks Liquidity Shock 🚨
subTitle:
☕ US Crypto News — Morning Briefing
Grab a coffee. This weekend wasn’t just volatile — it was revealing.

While global markets were distracted by chaos in silver, Bitcoin quietly told a different story.

🪙 Silver Implodes, Liquidity Vanishes

Silver futures went parabolic, touching record highs near $84, then collapsed over 10% in just one hour 😳
That kind of move isn’t normal — even for commodities.

📉 Reports (unconfirmed) spread on social media claiming a systemically important bank failed to meet a massive silver margin call, triggering forced liquidations and emergency liquidity demands exceeding $2B.

⚠️ No regulator or major outlet has confirmed a bank failure — but markets reacted anyway.

“Over $4B in silver longs got wiped out in just over an hour. Liquidity simply disappeared,”
— Analyst Shanaka Anslem

🏦 CME Steps In

As volatility exploded, the CME Risk Management Team quickly raised margin requirements across precious metals, signaling one thing clearly:

👉 Too much leverage had built up.
👉 Risk had to be cut — fast.

This pattern? We’ve seen it before… in both commodities and crypto.

₿ Bitcoin Catches the Flow

While silver traders were getting liquidated, Bitcoin moved the opposite way.

📈 As silver dumped ~11%, BTC caught a bid, briefly testing the $90,000 psychological level.

Crypto Rover summed it up perfectly:

“This looks like rotation, not new money.”

🔁 Leverage breaks → capital rotates → Bitcoin absorbs pressure

Some analysts urge caution on the collapse rumors — but one verified detail matters:

📄 JPMorgan disclosed ~$4.9B in unrealized silver losses
📄 Flipped from a huge short to holding ~750M ounces of physical silver

💬 “The collapse story may be fiction — but the position flip is real,”
— Shanaka Anslem

For crypto traders, that’s the real takeaway.

🔑 The Bigger Picture

This wasn’t just volatility.
This was liquidity stress.

When paper markets seize up, Bitcoin increasingly behaves like a pressure valve, not a risk asset.

📊 What to Watch Next

• XRP looks weak — but smart money is accumulating 👀
• 🇨🇳 China’s Digital Yuan may become interest-bearing by 2026
• ETH staking queue flips bullish after 3 months
• Gold signals hint BTC may be near a bottom
• 🇺🇸 Lummis’ crypto bill could reshape regulation
• Hyperliquid teases HYPE unlocks (Jan 6)

When leverage breaks somewhere, liquidity doesn’t disappear — it moves.
This weekend, a chunk of it chose Bitcoin 🚀

​Current Range: ETH is currently trading around $3,019, following a brief recovery from late-December lows near $2,920.
​Quarterly Downtrend: Despite a bullish summer where it peaked near $4,950, ETH has dropped roughly 27.6% in Q4, struggling to break through the major resistance level at $3,345.
​Technical Outlook: The immediate "consolidation band" is between $2,800 and $3,000. Traders are watching for a decisive break above $3,345 to signal a trend reversal, while the RSI (Relative Strength Index) near 32 suggests the asset is approaching oversold territory.
​Ecosystem Growth (The "Bull Case")
​While the price is sideways, the network metrics tell a much more aggressive growth story:
​Record Smart Contracts: Ethereum hit a new all-time high in Q4 2025 with 8.7 million smart contract deployments. This indicates that developer activity and dApp (decentralized app) creation are at their highest levels in history.
​Supply Tightening: Liquid supply is at historic lows. Only about 8.7% of total ETH supply remains on exchanges. The rest is increasingly locked in staking protocols, Layer 2 networks, or institutional custody.
​Layer 2 Dominance: The expansion of L2 solutions like Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism has successfully lowered gas fees, driving the surge in on-chain activity even during a price correction.
​Institutional & Macro Trends
​ETF Inflows: US spot ETH ETFs have matured significantly. Galaxy Digital reports that 2025 saw $23 billion in net inflows, with projections for even higher numbers in 2026 as wirehouses and major firms like Vanguard expand their crypto offerings.
​Real-World Assets (RWA): Ethereum has cemented itself as the primary layer for tokenized finance. Over $8.3 billion in tokenized assets (like US Treasuries) are now hosted on Ethereum, representing a 31% market share of all tokenized RWAs globally.

Trend & Structure
ETH often shows stronger percentage moves than BTC during bullish phases but also higher volatility.
Sustained higher lows generally indicate accumulation, while sharp pullbacks often reflect broader market risk-off sentiment.
Key Drivers
Staking & supply: ETH staking reduces liquid supply, which can support price during periods of strong demand.
Ecosystem growth: Layer-2 scaling solutions improve usability and can boost long-term fundamentals.
Macro & BTC correlation: ETH still follows Bitcoin’s overall market direction, especially in the short term.
Outlook

title: من يقوم بإنشاء هذه الميمات القبيحة؟
subTitle:
ملاحظة المحرر: عندما يتم الجمع بين الذكاء الاصطناعي والتوصية الخوارزمية والمضاربة المشفرة، يتم "تصنيع" الميمات على الإنترنت بشكل منهجي لحصاد الاهتمام والمال.
تبدأ هذه المقالة بسلسلة من المحتوى الهجومي الفيروسي على المنصات الاجتماعية، وتكشف كيف تخدم هذه الاتجاهات التي تبدو سخيفة منطق نشر عمليات الاحتيال المشفرة. يذكرنا أنه عندما لم تعد الشعبية متولدة عضويا ولكنها مصممة للربح، فإن الإنترنت يصبح أكثر فوضى وخطورة.
فيما يلي المقالة الأصلية:
مؤلف هذا المقال، المعروف على الإنترنت باسم Etymology Nerd، هو مؤلف كتاب "Algospeak: كيف تعيد وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي تشكيل اللغة".
هذا العام، ظهر جانب جديد مقلق ومزعج على Instagram Reels: يتم إنشاء الميمات الهجومية بشكل منهجي للترويج لعمليات احتيال العملات المشفرة - ولا أحد تقريبا يحاول إزالتها بجدية.
منذ يناير من هذا العام، بدأت مجموعة من الشخصيات الغريبة والمشوهة في الانتشار على هذه المنصة الاجتماعية. يرتبط ظهور هذه الظاهرة ارتباطا وثيقا بالتوافر الواسع النطاق لأدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي وتنظيم خطاب الكراهية المريح على منصة ميتا.
وتشمل هذه "جورج درويد"، وهي "صورة تناسخ" سايبورغ على غرار جورج فلويد الذي تم إنشاؤه في أبريل من هذا العام للترويج لعملة مشفرة تسمى $FLOYDAI؛ و"Kirkinator"، المولود في سبتمبر بعد وقت قصير من وفاة المعلق السياسي تشارلي كيرك، كان يستخدم لتضخيم رمز $KIRKINATOR. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، هناك سلسلة من صور "الصاحب" المتكررة مثل "إبسترون" و"ديديترون"، على التوالي في إشارة إلى جيفري إبشتاين ومغني الراب شون كومز (المعروف أيضا باسم ديدي).
توجد هذه الحسابات في نفس العالم السردي، وغالبا ما تكتسب حركة المرور من خلال تلبية الصور النمطية العنصرية والمعادية للسامية، وتراكم ملايين المشاهدات. غالبا ما تتميز مقاطع الفيديو القصيرة بلغة تمييزية وتدور مرارا وتكرارا حول المؤامرة الفرعية لما يسمى "التطهير العرقي".
الغرض الوحيد من هذا المحتوى الصادم هو توليد التفاعل والمشاركة. الهدف النهائي هو توجيه انتباه الجمهور إلى ما يسمى "عملات الميم"، وهو نوع من العملات المشفرة التي ترتفع نظريا في القيمة مع انتشار الميمات. استفادت عملات الميم المبكرة (مثل $DOGE) في الغالب من ثقافة الإنترنت الحالية، في حين أن الصور المشتقة مثل جورج درويد ونظرائه هي إبداعات اصطناعية بالكامل من قبل المضاربين في التشفير.
يبدأ هذا المخطط عادة ب pump.fun، وهي منصة تسمح للمستخدمين بتسجيل الرموز الرقمية وتداولها بسهولة. بمجرد أن ينشئ المطور رمزا مميزا جديدا، فإنه يشاركه في مجموعة Telegram موثوق بها أو مجتمع X، حيث يقوم المستثمرون بتبادل الأفكار حول طرق لتعزيز الاهتمام بشكل مصطنع للميم ذي الصلة، المعروف باسم "mindshare". ثم يستخدمون الذكاء الاصطناعي لإنشاء مقاطع فيديو استفزازية، على أمل جعل الميم ينتشر بشكل فيروسي ويجذب "المعتادين" - أولئك الذين ليسوا على دراية بثقافة عملات الميم ولكن الذين قد يتم جذبهم كمستثمرين في التجزئة. بعد ارتفاع سعر العملة، ستختار المجموعة الأساسية الأولية "سحب السجاد"، وبيع حيازاتها، والسحب النقدي، والخروج بالأرباح.
في الواقع، غالبا ما يكون الأشخاص الفعليون الذين يشترون هذه الرموز المميزة بضعة آلاف فقط. ومع ذلك، نظرا لأن الحاجز أمام إنشاء العملة المشفرة وإطلاق المحتوى الذي تم إنشاؤه بواسطة الذكاء الاصطناعي منخفض للغاية، يمكن لمنشئي العملات المعدنية إعادة تشغيل هذه الدورة بسهولة، والاستفادة من "تصنيع ظاهرة ثقافية".
في نفس الوقت، غالبا ما تبدأ هذه الميمات في "النمو عضويا". عندما يدرك المبدعون الآخرون إمكاناتهم الفيروسية، فإنهم يقلدونها ويعيدون إنتاجها مقابل المال أو النفوذ عبر الإنترنت. تم استخدام شخصيات "كيركيناتور" و"جورج درويد" مرارا وتكرارا من قبل شخصيات الإنترنت المختلفة التي لا علاقة لها بمنشئي الرموز الأصلية.
ومع ذلك، مع كل تكرار، لا يزال محتالو التشفير يستفيدون. على سبيل المثال، في أكتوبر، اكتسبت تغريدة عن كيركيناتور 8 ملايين مشاهدة، مما تسبب في ارتفاع سعر عملة كيركيناتور خمسة أضعاف، فقط ليتراجع في الأيام التالية. بالنسبة لأولئك المستثمرين الذين باعوا في ذروته، استند الربح إلى ملايين مستخدمي X الذين يشاهدون مقطع فيديو - حيث كان المحتوى "جورج درويد يقتل على يد كيركيناتور بعد سرقة ملفات إبشتاين".
لسوء الحظ، كلما كان الفيديو أكثر إثارة، كان من الأسهل انتشاره بشكل فيروسي. يمكن أن تجذب الصور العنيفة والهجومية المزيد من التعليقات وأوقات المشاهدة الأطول، وكلاهما يكافئ. تعلم منشئو العملات المعدنية استغلال هذه الآلية لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية. حتى مستخدمي Instagram أو X الذين لا يدركون هذه العملات المشفرة قد يجدون أنفسهم معرضين مرارا وتكرارا لمحتوى clickbait المزعج للغاية.
نحن ننجذب إلى دوامة: مواقع العملات المشفرة المنظمة بشكل فضفاض، وأدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي التي يمكن الوصول إليها بسهولة، والمنصات الاجتماعية التي تسمح بانتشار الميمات المسيئة، وكلها مكدسة فوق بعضها البعض.
بصفتي باحثا في تطور لغة الإنترنت، أشعر بقلق عميق من هذا: يتم إنشاء الاتجاهات عبر الإنترنت بشكل مصطنع، لغرض وحيد هو التلاعب بنا. لم يعد بإمكاننا التأكد من أن الميمات "تحدث بشكل طبيعي" - قد تكون في أي وقت جزءا من سلسلة مدفوعة بالربح.
حتى لو لم يتم إنشاء الميم مباشرة من قبل محتال التشفير، فسيتم اختياره دائما تقريبا من قبلهم على الفور تقريبا. يتم ترميز كل مرجع ثقافي جديد بسرعة على pump.fun وضخه بشكل مصطنع، كل ذلك لجعل بعض الناس يستفيدون منه.

subTitle:
Experts Predict Collapse of Companies Holding Bitcoin and Ethereum on Their Balance Sheets
By 2026, the public sector with cryptocurrency reserves (DAT) risks facing a major crisis. Shares of many major players have already fallen, and industry representatives forecast further deterioration, reports Cointelegraph.

In 2025, many firms offering investors access to cryptocurrencies through shares entered the market. During the October Bitcoin rally, the sector attracted billions of dollars, but the subsequent correction seriously impacted the capitalization of these enterprises.

Gloomy Forecast
Co-founder of MoreMarkets, Altan Tutar, described the sector's prospects as "gloomy." In his opinion, market saturation will lead to the closure of most such structures.

The first to go will be companies focused on altcoins: they will not be able to maintain a market valuation above the value of assets on their balance sheets. Tutar believes that, following them, holders of large coins like Ethereum, Solana, and XRP will also be affected.

Only those who offer investors additional value will survive. This refers to products that generate stable income from assets, which can be distributed among shareholders.

Business Model Shift
Co-founder of Solv Protocol, Ryan Chow, noted that the number of companies holding the first cryptocurrency increased from 70 to 130 in just six months. However, a strategy of simple accumulation no longer guarantees success.

According to Chow, many market participants used buying digital gold merely as a marketing move without a real financial structure. Now, they are forced to sell assets to cover operational expenses.

The expert is confident that the approach must change: from speculation to structured capital management. Bitcoin should be used in transparent income-generating instruments, not left on the balance sheet as "dead weight."

Threat from ETFs
CEO of First Digital, Vincent Chok, sees the main threat to DAT companies in competition with spot ETFs. Investors are increasingly choosing exchange-traded funds as a simpler and more regulated instrument. The situation was worsened by the easing of rules in the US, allowing ETFs to include staking income.

To stay afloat, crypto companies will need to meet the standards of traditional finance. This requires full transparency, auditability, and compliance procedures at the level of institutional players.

Recall that CoinShares researcher James Butterfill stated that the "treasury" company bubble has effectively burst.#ETH #sol #Xrp🔥🔥

随着时间和技术的不断迭代，人类文明或许只是过渡文明。从生物的演化角度看，人类的身体越来越柔弱，其生命形态也并不具备超长待机的基础条件，就算不出现AI，人类通过自然演化也会消失。

另一个先决的条件，人类文明内部出现矛盾，也远大于AI带来的威胁。对于超级智能体而言人类存在，并不会阻碍超级智能体无限扩展，反而会促进他们理解生物演化。

For short-term trading, this structure means there will be a lot of noise and back-and-forth losses; however, for medium-term trading, as long as the larger trend structure is not broken, this kind of time-for-space consolidation often provides room for those with patience. This isn’t a call to mindlessly leverage your position, but a reminder: don’t be scared off by the sentiment index, and don’t let short-term fluctuations amplify your fears. Use your own trading system to understand this consolidation—reduce positions when necessary, invest regularly when appropriate, and keep both your positions and mindset under your control to be qualified for the next genuine trend. Rationality will always reach the finish line ahead of emotions.

How I’m Interpreting This ETH Trading Case on Lighter

This is one of those data points that makes me pause and look twice.

According to on-chain and API monitoring, a wallet that deposited just $5,000 USDC into Lighter about two months ago has reportedly grown its capital to around $133,000, mainly by trading ETH. That’s roughly a 26× increase, or about +2,560%.

What stands out to me isn’t just the return — it’s the behavior. Over the past seven days, this single address appears to have contributed nearly 59% of ETHUSD market-making volume on Lighter, accounting for about $1.72 billion in notional volume and roughly 9% of total trades. That level of activity suggests a systematic market-making strategy, not random speculation.

Another interesting detail is that the account seems to be trading with zero fees, and aside from the initial $5,000 deposit, there’s no evidence of additional capital being added. That makes the performance harder to dismiss, while still raising questions worth monitoring.

To be clear, profitable market-making alone doesn’t imply wash trading — that would require self-matching orders. But given the starting size and the scale of impact, this is the kind of case that deserves scrutiny.

I’m not drawing conclusions yet.

But it’s a reminder that on-chain markets are increasingly shaped by algorithms, not narratives — and understanding that shift matters more than chasing screenshots.

quoteContent.title: Top 5 Low-Cap Cryptocurrencies to Buy Right Now (Beyond Bitcoin): ETH, SOL, and More
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:
Bitcoin often steals the spotlight, but history shows that the biggest percentage gains usually come from altcoins, especially those with strong fundamentals and growing adoption. As the crypto market stabilizes in late 2025, many investors are looking beyond BTC for smart, lower-risk exposure heading into 2026.
This guide highlights five high-potential cryptocurrencies worth watching right now focusing on solid ecosystems, real use cases, and long-term growth rather than pure hype.

🔍 What Do We Mean by “Low-Cap” Here?
In crypto terms, “low-cap” doesn’t always mean tiny or unknown. In this context, it means:
Assets with more upside potential than BitcoinStill early in their adoption curve compared to BTCStrong fundamentals but not fully priced in yet
Coins like Ethereum and Solana may already be large caps, but relative to Bitcoin’s dominance, they still offer significant growth headroom.

🪙 1. Ethereum ($ETH ) — The Backbone of Web3
Ethereum remains the most important smart-contract blockchain in crypto. Despite market cycles, ETH continues to dominate:
DeFi (Aave, Uniswap, Curve)Stablecoins (USDT, USDC)NFTs, RWAs, and Layer-2 ecosystems
Why ETH still has upside:
Ongoing Layer-2 adoption reduces feesInstitutional interest in ETH staking & ETFsDeflationary supply mechanics post-merge
ETH may not deliver 100x returns, but it offers strong risk-adjusted upside beyond Bitcoin.
👉 ETH price:
[https://www.binance.com/en/price/ethereum](https://www.binance.com/en/price/ethereum)

{spot}(ETHUSDT)

⚡ 2. Solana ($SOL ) — High-Performance Layer-1
Solana has emerged as one of the fastest-growing ecosystems in crypto. Known for ultra-low fees and high throughput, SOL is attracting:
DeFi tradersNFT platformsGaming and consumer apps
Why Solana stands out now:
Rising on-chain volume and active usersStrong meme coin and retail activityGrowing institutional interest
As adoption expands, SOL could continue to outperform many older Layer-1s.
👉 SOL price:
[https://www.binance.com/en/price/solana](https://www.binance.com/en/price/solana)

{spot}(SOLUSDT)

🔗 3. Chainlink ($LINK ) — Powering Real-World Data
Chainlink plays a critical role in crypto infrastructure by providing secure data feeds (oracles) for blockchains. As tokenization and real-world assets grow, reliable data becomes essential.
Why LINK is a strong bet:
Integral to DeFi and derivativesUsed by banks and institutions testing on-chain settlementBenefiting from the RWA (Real World Asset) narrative
LINK is less speculative and more infrastructure-driven, making it attractive for long-term investors.
👉 LINK price:
[https://www.binance.com/en/price/chainlink](https://www.binance.com/en/price/chainlink)

{spot}(LINKUSDT)

🧩 4. Arbitrum (ARB ) — Ethereum’s Scaling Leader
Arbitrum is one of Ethereum’s top Layer-2 networks, designed to make transactions cheaper and faster while maintaining security.
Why ARB is worth watching:
High DeFi total value locked (TVL)Growing developer ecosystemIncreased demand as Ethereum usage rises
As more users move to Layer-2s, Arbitrum could capture a significant share of Ethereum’s activity.
👉 ARB price:
[https://www.binance.com/en/price/arbitrum](https://www.binance.com/en/price/arbitrum)

{spot}(ARBUSDT)

🧠 5. Avalanche (AVAX) — Custom Blockchains & Institutions
Avalanche focuses on subnets, allowing institutions and enterprises to build customized blockchains. This makes it attractive for:
Gaming studiosFinancial institutionsTokenized asset platforms
Why AVAX has long-term potential:
Institutional partnershipsHigh scalability and fast finalityGrowing ecosystem beyond retail speculation
AVAX offers a blend of enterprise adoption + DeFi exposure, which could play out well into 2026.
👉 AVAX price:
[https://www.binance.com/en/price/avalanche](https://www.binance.com/en/price/avalanche)

📊 How to Build Smart Exposure (Beyond Bitcoin)
Instead of chasing hype, consider a balanced approach:
Core holdings: ETH, SOLInfrastructure plays: LINK, ARBInnovation & enterprise: AVAX
You can reduce risk further by:
Using Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA)Avoiding leverageHolding a portion in stablecoins for future dips
⚠️ Risk Reminder
Even strong altcoins are volatile. Prices can move sharply during pullbacks. Always:
Invest only what you can afford to loseDiversify across sectorsAvoid emotional trading

🏁 Final Thoughts
Bitcoin sets the direction, but altcoins often deliver the acceleration. As we move toward 2026, cryptocurrencies like Ethereum, Solana, Chainlink, Arbitrum, and Avalanche offer compelling opportunities beyond BTC with real technology, adoption, and long-term relevance.
For investors seeking smarter exposure, focusing on fundamentals over hype could make all the difference in the next phase of the cycle.

⚠ BlackRock Transfers $200M in BTC and ETH as ETF Pressure Persists

As selling across crypto funds continues, BlackRock moved a large batch of $BTC and Ethereum in late December - a move that caught market attention.

On-chain data from Arkham [Note: Check... specifically reports from Dec 24 indicate 2,292 BTC and 9,976 ETH valued at ~$230M] shows 2,201 BTC and 7,557 $ETH were sent to Coinbase Prime, with a combined value above $214M at the time.

📉 The transfers came as ETF outflows accelerated. On Dec 26, Bitcoin ETFs recorded $275.9M in net outflows [Note: Check... SoSoValue data specifically confirms $276M], with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for most of the move ($193M). Ethereum ETFs also saw net exits, according to SoSoValue.

Zooming out, crypto ETPs have now seen $3.2B in outflows since the October correction, with pressure remaining steady into year-end.

💡 The takeaway: this doesn’t confirm aggressive selling, but large institutional transfers during sustained outflows usually signal caution - not accumulation.

title: Vì sao  Ethereum vẫn còn dư địa tăng mạnh trong năm 2026
subTitle:
Gm anh em buổi sáng nha 
Dù Bitcoin vẫn đang giữ vai trò dẫn dắt tâm lý chung của thị trường, mình quan sát thấy sự chú ý đang dần chuyển hướng sang Ethereum. Theo quan điểm của nhà đầu tư Tom Lee, $ETH  có thể tiến tới vùng giá 7.000–9.000 USD vào đầu năm 2026, không phải nhờ sự thổi phồng nhất thời, mà đến từ mức độ ứng dụng ngày càng sâu của Ethereum trong hệ thống tài chính toàn cầu.
Từ góc nhìn của mình khi theo dõi on-chain và các sản phẩm DeFi, những biến động giá ngắn hạn gần đây không làm thay đổi cấu trúc dài hạn. 
Sau cú sốc thanh lý mạnh trong năm trước, thị trường đang dần ổn định trở lại, thanh khoản được tái phân bổ, trong khi Ethereum tiếp tục củng cố vị thế như một lớp hạ tầng cốt lõi cho mã hóa tài sản, thanh toán xuyên biên giới, stablecoin và các ứng dụng dành cho tổ chức.
Một điểm quan trọng khác mà mình chú ý là Ethereum đang trở thành lớp settlement mặc định cho nhiều dòng tiền mới, từ RWAs, ETF cho tới các sản phẩm tài chính lai.
 Điều này tạo ra nhu cầu thực, bền vững đối với ETH, không chỉ để đầu cơ mà còn để vận hành hệ thống. Nói một cách đơn giản, theo mình, tiếng ồn ngắn hạn rồi sẽ phai nhạt, nhưng tác dụng thực tế và vai trò nền tảng của Ethereum sẽ còn ở lại. 
Chính yếu tố này mới là cơ sở để ETH có thể bước vào một pha định giá cao hơn trong chu kỳ 2025–2026.

translatedData.title: What’s Next for Cryptocurrencies in 2026??
translatedData.subTitle: Economic forecasts for 2026 indicate a phase of "institutional maturity" for the cryptocurrency market, where Bitcoin is expected to become a globally recognized reserve asset. Analysts believe that this year will witness a boom in "tokenization of traditional assets," integrating stock and real estate markets with blockchain technology in unprecedented ways. From a regulatory standpoint, legislative frameworks in major economies are expected to be completed, reducing the severity of random fluctuations and attracting massive liquidity from pension and hedge funds. Experts also anticipate tremendous growth in Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs), which could change the concept of international payments. Technically, layer two solutions will reach peak efficiency, making transaction fees nearly negligible and driving mass adoption of decentralized applications. Despite the optimism, economists warn that the gap will widen between currencies with real utility value and "meme coins" that may face legal marginalization. Ultimately, 2026 is seen as a year for solidifying digital financial stability away from mere price speculation.

🔗 What Really Happened in Crypto in 2025 - and What’s Next

2025 was supposed to be the $BTC  bull run. Instead, it became the year crypto fully entered the financial system - without the classic euphoria.

🧩 What defined 2025?

• Institutionalization won - ETFs, funds, and corporate treasuries now hold ~13% of $BTC  supply

• Bitcoin peaked near $120k, but the explosive phase never came

• Trump-era politics drove volatility: tariffs, memecoins, Bitcoin reserve headlines

• Record $20B liquidations (Oct 10) broke momentum and confidence

• Stablecoins + RWA exploded - real adoption, real cash flows

• DEX derivatives (Hyperliquid) challenged CEX dominance

🧠 The big shift?

Crypto didn’t replace TradFi - it merged with it. Blockchain became infrastructure, not rebellion.

📉 Why the bull run felt “wrong”?

• Fewer retail traders

• Less leverage-driven hype

• More controlled, ETF-led flows

• Cycles no longer cleanly follow halvings

Some say 4-year cycles are breaking.

Others say they’re just stretching.

The market is slower, heavier, more institutional.

The next big move won’t reward hype - it will reward positioning.

"The Wealth of Nations","The Principles of Taxation","General Theory","Capital"

The first three books are not worth much discussion as they basically laid the foundation of modern economics, while "Capital" is quite interesting. The content of "Capital" should not be called "Capital"; it should be called a perspective on capital operation from a human viewpoint, a work that is critically engaging from an individual perspective. Of course, for people, whenever they look at it, it feels good, and even for many years to come, as long as there is business and class, it can always feel good.

However, the economy is not simply driven by labor and industrial output. Any system close to that of "Capital" has fallen into madness regarding industrial output and labor. A perfect example is the former Soviet Union, which demonstrated to the world what it means to produce for the sake of production, leading to the exploitation of the labor class.

I am a bit worried that the domestic situation will fall into subsidizing production for the sake of production, subsequently leading to the dumping of assets. Take the example of new energy vehicles; in recent years, dozens of new energy vehicle manufacturers have emerged in various industries. Around 2020, I already felt that new energy vehicle manufacturers had saturated the market. At that time, many car companies were unable to sustain themselves, and then over the past few years, a large number of enterprises have been drawn in. In the end, the ones that can truly survive will not exceed two hands, and the rest will have to sell their assets at a loss.

Many of these are very excellent companies that got involved, with a lot of capital being repeatedly invested, but without achieving product differentiation, thus wasting time and energy. This is not just the case in the new energy sector; many other industries are the same.

《国富论》《赋税原理》《通论》《资本论》

前三部没什么好讲基本奠定了现代经济学基础，而资本论就很有趣，资本论所写的内容，不应该叫资本论，应该叫以人的视角看待资本运转，一种从个人角度极具批判性的著作，当然对于人而言何时看，何时爽，甚至再过许多年只要有商业、阶级存在就可以一直爽。

但经济并不是单纯依靠劳动力和工业产值驱动，凡是于与资本论的靠近的体系，都在工业产值和劳动力上陷入过疯狂，拿前苏联举列完美向世人演示一遍什么叫做为了生产而生产的劳动阶级剥削。

我有点担心国内会陷入到为了生产而补贴生产，进而贱卖资产的事情。拿新能源汽车举列子，国内过去几年数十家新能源汽车厂商，陆陆续续各行各业都去做新能源汽车，2020年左右我都感觉新能源汽车厂商已经饱和，那时候许多车企已经坚持不下去，然后这几年又陆续卷入一大堆企业进入，最后真正能活下来的不会超过两只手，剩下的都要贱卖资产。

很多都是非常优秀的企业卷入进去，大量的资本重复投入，而没有做到产品差异化，进而浪费时间和精力，不止新能源一个行业，还有许许多多的行业都是一个样子。

#ETH  Yesterday afternoon, Ether laid out a short position near 3017, and the market has already made it very clear.

This rebound has not been healthy; prices have risen, but trading volume has not kept up, and the high position has started to grind sideways repeatedly.

An experienced trader can tell at a glance that this is not a state of accelerated upward movement, but rather an attempt to find an exit for profit-taking. The area above 3010 is itself a previous zone of dense trading, where both bulls and bears are squeezed together, and trying to break through directly is inherently difficult.

The real key is the rhythm. A high position that does not rise is itself a risk. In the market, bulls are becoming increasingly hesitant to chase prices, while bears are slowly gaining the upper hand. In this situation, as long as capital chooses to exert force, the pullback will definitely be swift and severe.

That subsequent big bearish candle dropped directly from 3017 to 2912 without hesitation; this is the result of emotions and structure being released together. With the market reaching this point, the first phase of the decline has already been completed, so at 2912, I decisively told my fans to take their profits and not fall in love with the market.

After so many years, I have always only taken the parts I understand and can hold steady.

When the market offers profits, you should seize them; when the market starts to change flavor, you should walk away.

Whether one can survive in the long term often hinges on whether this knife can be held steady.

I am Old Zhang, skilled in short to medium-term contracts and medium to long-term spot layouts!

content:
#ETH 昨天下午以太在3017附近布局做空，其实盘面已经给得很明白了。

这一段反弹走得并不健康，价格抬高，但成交量跟不上，高位开始反复横着磨。

老盘一看就知道，这不是要加速上攻的状态，更像是在给获利盘找出口。3010上方本身就是前期密集成交区，多空筹码挤在一起，想直接突破，难度本来就不小。

真正关键的是节奏。高位横盘不涨，本身就是风险。盘口里多头追价越来越犹豫，而空头开始慢慢占优，这种情况下，只要资金选择发力，回落一定又快又狠。

后面那根大阴线直接从3017砸到2912，没有拖泥带水，这就是情绪和结构一起释放的结果。行情走到这一步，第一段下跌已经完成，所以在2912果断叫粉丝收刀止盈，不和市场谈恋爱。

做了这么多年，我一直只吃自己看得懂、拿得稳的那一段。

行情给利润的时候要接，行情开始变味的时候要走。

能不能长期活下来，往往就差这一刀收不收得住。

我是老张，擅长中短线合约、中长线现货布局！

Cryptocurrency Trading Practical 8 Sentences, Understand to Avoid Detours
1. Continuous small rises will lead to large rises, be patient and hold your position without panic
2. Continuous large rises require exiting the market, take profits and don't be greedy
3. During declines, if you encounter small rises, watch for rebound opportunities
4. During rises, if you encounter small declines, short-term adjustments are normal
5. Small rises against the trend hide large bullish signals, indicating signs of trend reversal
6. Small declines in line with the trend continue deep waves, bearish strength still shows
7. Sudden drops with low volume are intimidation tactics, don't panic during the main force's washout
8. Gradual declines with increased volume require quick exits, don't stubbornly resist the collapse of the bulls #BTC #ETH
